purpose: Evaluate whether evidence prerequisites for a bounded service-delivery admission are satisfied without authorizing or beginning delivery.

evidence: deliverables/exclusions/change-stop conditions unchanged or separately amended

contract_lifecycle_requirement.rule: Resolve profile value. REQUIRED needs authentic CONTRACT_LIFECYCLE_EXECUTED evidence; NOT_REQUIRED_BY_PACKAGE does not synthesize execution; ENGAGEMENT_SPECIFIC must be resolved from accepted terms.

deposit_payment_prerequisite.rule: Resolve profile value. REQUIRED needs the exact accepted payment/deposit predicate satisfied; NOT_REQUIRED_BY_PACKAGE does not imply free service; ENGAGEMENT_SPECIFIC must be resolved from accepted terms.

customer_source_data_authority.rule: When customer material/data/system access is in scope, retain attributable permission and handling boundaries; absence of needed authority FAIL_CLOSED.

maturity_release_constraint.rule: Delivery may not exceed canonical product/service maturity or represent unreleased/unproven substrate as released/production.

professional_regulatory_provider_depende.rule: Each applicable external dependency must be SATISFIED, NOT_APPLICABLE, or retained unresolved; unresolved required dependency FAIL_CLOSED.

delivery_owner.rule: An authentic offering-specific operational owner/admission path must be identified. Package text or this envelope is not itself a delivery owner.

disposition.authorization_rule: Complete admission evidence may be presented to an authentically identified accountable offering owner. That owner may return ALLOW, DENY or FAIL_CLOSED as a commercial/service-start decision using the owner-decision evidence contract; no machine admission interface is required for professional/service work.
disposition.runtime_separation: Any consequential software execution remains separately governed by its native runtime/admissibility owner and cannot inherit SERVICE_DELIVERY_AUTHORIZED.

privacy: Retain customer/private source material, provider IDs, credentials and sensitive evidence outside public repository records; public evidence may retain bounded disposition and authorized redacted/hash references.
prohibitions: Does not authorize or begin delivery
Does not create Task Registry/COSV authority
